item.title: Salah Bar 2.38.0
item.description:
• 🔔 All notifications in one place: each prayer's adhan, the reminders before prayer time and every other reminder are now in Settings → Notifications, which opens first.
  • 🗂️ A clearer Settings order with an icon for each page, a Prayer Log page, and search that also finds a setting by its old name.
  • 🕌 A More menu in the panel gathers Nearby mosques, the timetable, tasbih, the 99 Names, zakat and more, in the same order as on the phone.
  • 📖 This week's khutbah opens inside the app for Türkiye. ✨ What's new lists it all after the update.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.37.0
item.description:
• 🌅 A living sky behind the next prayer and in the widgets, following your day with the sun and the moon's phase.
  • 🌦️ The weather is off by default. If you turn it on (Settings → Appearance), your location rounded to about 10 km goes to Open-Meteo at most every 30 minutes, and nothing else.
  • ⏳ Time left to pray, and the times to avoid prayer by your madhhab.
  • 🧳 Travel mode: far from home, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha shortened, and combined where your madhhab allows.
  • 🕌 Jumu'ah mode for brothers: quiet during the khutbah. 📒 A weekly reflection in the Prayer Log. ✨ What's new lists it all after the update.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.36.0
item.description:
• 🔄 Sync keeps your settings: if the other device leaves one out (Windows 1.10 leaves out For sisters and jama'ah), this Mac keeps its own value. Update Salah Bar on every device you sync with.
  • 📒 The prayer log moves to a file of its own. If you go back to 2.35 afterwards, its Prayer Log shows up empty.
  • 🕌 New: a zakat calculator, Quran search and bookmarks, the 99 Names, iqama times from your mosque, a printable timetable and Ramadan imsakiye, a qada planner, and Export all my data / Restore.
  • 🌙 On the Mac too: For sisters, Reading and voice, the Qibla on a map. ✨ What's new lists it all after the update.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.35.1
item.description: ⭐ Jama'ah and masjid achievements in the Prayer Log: prayers in the masjid and in jama'ah, Fajr and Isha in the masjid, your masjid streak and the forty days of all five in jama'ah (at-Tirmidhi 241).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.35.0
item.description: 🔎 Search every setting, with what needs your attention at the top. 🕌 Brothers can log a prayer as prayed in jama'ah or in the masjid (Settings → Reminders → Prayer Log). 🌙 For sisters: the Mac follows the excused days logged on your iPhone. ✨ What's new lists it all after the update.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.34.0
item.description: 🌅 Counts down to sunrise after Fajr, when the time to pray Fajr ends (General). 🕌 Nearby mosques: the Mosques button beside the Qibla. 📿 Tasbih in the Duas window. 🔕 Your iPhone can stay silent at prayer time while you're on the Mac. 🧹 A new reminder clears the earlier ones. ✨ What's new after each update.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.33.1
item.description: ⏩ The Quran speed button is in the menu's mini-player too, next to play.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.33.0
item.description:
• ⏩ Quran speed: a speed button in the Quran window's player bar plays the recitation from 0.5× to 2×, with the reciter's voice kept natural. Hifz keeps its own speed.
  • VoiceOver reads the names of the icon-only buttons in the menu, the mini-player, the Quran window and Reminders settings, in the app's language.
  • macOS itself in every app language: Siri phrases and the permission prompts.
  • Reminders in the hour repeated when the clocks go back fire at the right time instead of an hour early.
  • Sync file: another device's changes written at the same moment are no longer lost.
  • Suhoor wakes: Settings shows when they no longer match your city or calculation, with Update….

item.title: Salah Bar 2.32.0
item.description:
• 🗓️ Hijri month calendar: click the Hijri date in the menu to see the whole month, with the Islamic days marked (in Turkish, the Kandil nights too).
  • 🔄 Sync with Android: Settings → General → Sync file keeps your settings, cities, prayer log, Ramadan log, Quran progress and khatma in one file in your own cloud drive (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox…), which the Android app reads too. iCloud keeps working beside it.
  • After Isha, tomorrow's Fajr is named as tomorrow's schedule names it (Turkish: Sabah in Ramadan, İmsak otherwise), also the night before Ramadan starts.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.31.1
item.description: Fixes the desktop widgets being nearly unreadable (pale text on a white card) in dark appearance. Turkish prayer names follow Diyanet (Sabah vs İmsak in Ramadan).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.31.0
item.description:
• 📖 The Mushaf can now follow reciters that have no ayah timings. mp3quran.net publishes timings for only 115 of the 288 recitations; for the others the Mushaf now estimates them from the pauses in the recording, and then follows and skips ayah by ayah (labelled approximate). A downloaded surah is estimated by itself; for a streamed one, press Estimate from the audio in the notice under the page.
  • The Mushaf says when a reciter has no ayah timings, instead of silently estimating the page and skipping by surah.
  • In the Quran window, reciters with ayah timings carry a small mark, and a Timed filter lists only them.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.30.1
item.description: • 🎧 The Quran window follows what's playing: when a recitation starts from the menu bar, a routine, the khatma or Siri, or moves on to another reciter, the window shows that reciter's surahs and scrolls to the one playing, so the next surah is one click away.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.30.0
item.description: • New: control the recitation from the Mushaf window. Previous ayah, play/pause and next ayah sit in the middle of its bottom bar, and the space bar plays and pauses. With nothing playing, play starts from the page you're reading.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.29.1
item.description:
• Fixed: the Mushaf stopped turning pages with the recitation after you went to an ayah (⌘G) or opened an ayah's translation. Pressing play now follows the recitation again, and opening the Mushaf while a recitation plays shows its page.
  • Fixed: going to an ayah on the printed pages (Madani, Shamarly, IndoPak) the first time could open a nearby page instead.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.29.0
item.description:
• ✓ Ticking off prayers is easier: each prayer that has begun shows an empty check, and a click anywhere on its row marks it prayed.
  • 🔔 The panel warns when macOS has turned off Salah Bar's notifications (with a button to turn them on), and when the adhan won't be heard: reminders and adhan off, its volume at zero, or your Mac's sound muted.
  • Settings is grouped into Prayer Times, Reminders and Adhan, and Worship, with Off beside the adhan and reminders while they're off. The main switch is now called Reminders and adhan, and no longer greys out Sunnah tracking.
  • The welcome tour asks for location and notifications with its main button, with Not Now beside it.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.28.0
item.description:
• 📖 New: translations and tafsir in the Mushaf. Right-click any ayah for its translation or tafsir in a panel under the page, with the ayahs before and after a click away; or show the translation under every ayah.
  • About 80 translations in every language and the classic Arabic tafsirs (Ibn Kathir, al-Tabari, al-Qurtubi, al-Sa'di, al-Muyassar, al-Jalalayn and more), from Quran for Android. Each downloads the first time you show it, then works offline.
  • ⌘G goes to any ayah: type 2:255, Baqarah 255 or البقرة ٢٥٥.
  • Settings → Quran → Translations and Tafsir chooses them and manages the downloads.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.27.0
item.description:
• ⏱️ New: how long the khatma takes. The Khatma view shows the whole Quran and what you have left with the chosen reciter, and how much a day to finish in a day, a week or a month; one click makes it your daily goal.
  • Compare Reciters lists your favourites by how long the khatma takes with each, fastest first.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.26.1
item.description:
• ⚙️ New: Settings → Khatma, with your progress, the daily and monthly goals, the reminder and the widget option in one place.
  • The Khatma widget updates every minute while you listen, and right away when you play or pause (it waited five minutes before).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.26.0
item.description:
• 📊 New: Salah Bar Khatma widget (Small, Medium, Large). Your khatma progress, today's and this month's goals with your streak, the month as a calendar shaded by how much of each day's goal you heard, and the 30 juz. Add it from Edit Widgets.
  • Settings → Appearance → Show the khatma in the Large widget adds a line with the khatma's progress, today's goal and the last seven days to the prayer widget.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.25.0
item.description:
• 📖 New: Khatma in the Quran window. It counts what you actually hear, with any reciter, shows the juz and surahs still missing, and Continue Khatma plays the parts you haven't heard yet, skipping what you have. Completed khatmas are kept in a log.
  • 🎯 Khatma goals: a daily goal in pages or minutes, a monthly goal in khatmas (calendar or Hijri month, e.g. Ramadan), and an optional reminder at a time you choose on days a goal isn't met yet.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.24.1
item.description:
• 🌐 New: Settings → Quran → Detect sound in browsers too (more accurate). Pause for other sounds now also works for WhatsApp Web, Slack in a browser or a YouTube video, and the Quran carries on as soon as you pause one. It measures how loud other apps are (macOS asks once for System Audio Recording; nothing is recorded or kept).
  • Pause for other sounds ignores short notification sounds better and no longer pauses for the gap between two songs of music already playing.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.24.0
item.description: • ⏸️ New: Settings → Quran → Pause for other sounds. When another app starts playing sound or recording (a WhatsApp or Slack voice message, a video, or recording one yourself), the Quran and the duas pause, and carry on a moment after it ends.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.23.0
item.description:
• 🕌 Listening to a dhikr card no longer leaves the Quran stopped: it pauses for the dhikr and carries on after it. Closing the card (✕) stops its recording, and the Quran carries on.
  • 🔊 New: Settings → Adhkar → Reading aloud. In the hours you choose, a card's recording plays by itself as it appears. Never in a meeting or a call, with the camera or microphone in use, or with Focus on: then the card comes silently, as before.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.22.2
item.description: • 📖 The Mushaf now follows the ayah being recited also while paused: it turns to its page and highlights it, and the Follow button goes there. Opening the Mushaf also turns to the recited page.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.22.1
item.description: • 📖 In a short Mushaf window, the page now scrolls instead of being cut off, and the ayah being recited is kept in view as the recitation moves on or the window is resized.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.22.0
item.description:
• 📖 The floating Mushaf now looks like a printed mushaf: each page sits on paper inside a gilded double frame with stars at the corners, and its number in a rosette at the bottom.
  • With printed pages side by side, their credit now shows once under both.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.21.0
item.description:
• Morning and evening adhkar is now a reminder of its own (Settings → Adhkar), with or without the dhikr cards. Its card asks whether to recite them all aloud; only if you accept, it plays Hisn al-Muslim's recordings and opens them in the Duas window to read along.
  • In Arabic, the Quran window's Hifz, Mushaf and Downloads buttons were hidden in the toolbar's » menu. They now show, as do the Duas window's.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.20.0
item.description:
• The floating Mushaf has a Turkish style: the pages of the Diyanet mushaf (ayet berkenar, 605 pages), in the Uthmani script.
  • No focus ring around the Mushaf's next-page button when the window opens.
  • The Duas button now shows 🤲🏻.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.19.0
item.description:
• 📖 Mushaf styles: besides the Uthmani and Naskh text, the printed pages of the Madani, Shamarly and IndoPak mushaf, downloaded as you read, with the ayah being recited boxed on the page.
  • 📖 One page or two side by side, like an open mushaf.
  • 🛠 In a wide window the text stays in a comfortable column; the scroll bar shows only while scrolling.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.18.0
item.description:
• 📖 A floating Mushaf: the page being recited, above your other windows (even full-screen ones) without taking focus, turning by itself, with the ayah being recited highlighted for reciters with ayah timings and in Hifz mode. Click an ayah to listen from it.
  • ✍️ Two styles: Uthmani (Madani) or Simple (Naskh); light, sepia or dark; text size and see-through. Open it from 📖 in the panel's Quran player, the Quran window or the daily wird card.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.17.0
item.description:
• 🕰️ Routines and a daily wird (Settings → Routines): read the whole Quran a few pages a day from where you stopped, with today's pages in the panel; and have the wird, a surah, the morning adhkar or a Hifz review start after a prayer, at a set time, or when a Focus turns on. A routine asks first (Play or Later) or starts by itself, and waits during calls, meetings and the adhan.
  • ⚡ Run Routine in Shortcuts, and a Salah Bar filter for any Focus.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.16.0
item.description:
• 🤲 Duas you can listen to: all of Hisn al-Muslim, 267 duas in 132 chapters by topic, each with its Arabic, its meaning and a recording. Play a chapter, count repetitions, keep them offline (🕌 → Duas…).
  • ▶ Listen on dhikr cards, where Hisn al-Muslim has a recording of the same words.
  • 👋 A new welcome tour that sets everything up: your prayer times and method, the adhan, and a switch for each optional feature. Take it from the card in the panel.
  • 🌍 Four new languages: Deutsch, বাংলা, فارسی and Español (12 in all).
  • 🛠 Long prayer names no longer wrap in the panel, and translations are more consistent.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.15.1
item.description:
• ✨ Dhikr cards at any interval: choose hours and minutes yourself (10 minutes to 12 hours) within your period (Settings → Adhkar).
  • 🛠 Fixed: after an update the desktop widget could stay blank until the Mac restarted.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.15.0
item.description:
• ✨ Dhikr cards (Settings → Adhkar, off until you turn it on): now and then a quiet card with a dhikr or dua from the Quran and the Sunnah, at the hours you choose, with the morning and evening adhkar. Never during meetings, calls or Focus.
  • 🇷🇺 Русский: Russian is the eighth language.
  • A small legend shows which check is the Sunnah and which the fard.
  • Ayah and hadith sources in your language.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.14.0
item.description:
• 🌙 A Ramadan companion (Settings → Ramadan, all optional): your fasts and fasts to make up, the iftar and Laylat al-Qadr duas, a Quran khatm plan you can listen to, suhoor / Taraweeh / Laylat al-Qadr reminders, waking the Mac for suhoor, an iftar countdown in the menu bar, iftar and Taraweeh in your calendar, a Ramadan widget, and the six days of Shawwal.
  • ✅ Sunnah prayers: an optional small check beside each prayer for its Sunnah (Settings → Reminders → Prayer Log).
  • The widgets show the Salah Bar icon in the widget gallery.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.13.0
item.description:
• 🌍 Four new languages: اردو, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu and Français, alongside English, Türkçe and العربية (Settings → General → Language).
  • ✅ "Did you pray Asr?" An optional reminder when a prayer has not been ticked off, with a Prayed ✓ button (Settings → Reminders).
  • Turkish prayer notifications are now in Turkish.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.12.1
item.description:
• 🛠 Fixed: Salah Bar could close when switching to or from Arabic while the Quran window was open.
  • 👋 Set Salah Bar up before the welcome tour existed? The menu panel now offers it once.
  • In English, sources read "Quran 20:114", "Bukhari" and "Muslim".

item.title: Salah Bar 2.12.0
item.description:
• 🌕 The White Days: from the 12th to the 15th of each Hijri month, the panel shows the three moons and the hadith «إذا صمتَ من الشهر ثلاثة أيام فصُم ثلاث عشرة وأربع عشرة وخمس عشرة». One click turns on a reminder the evening before.
  • 🔔 Sunnah fast reminders now quote the hadith for the White Days, Mondays and Thursdays.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.11.0
item.description:
• 👋 A welcome tour that guides new users step by step: language, location, notifications and the adhan, and what is inside. Open it again from Settings → General.
  • 🌙 The hadith «الصلاة على وقتها» in the Amiri typeface.
  • 📍 No more preset cities (İzmir, Doha, Cairo): Salah Bar follows your location and you add the cities you want. Unused presets are removed; ones you use stay.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.10.0
item.description:
• ⚙️ New Settings window, laid out like System Settings: a sidebar of pages for General, Prayer Times, Iqama, Reminders, Adhan, Quran, Calendar and more.
  • 🌙 A new welcome with the hadith «الصلاة على وقتها»: "Prayer at its time" is the deed most beloved to Allah.
  • 📖 Hifz for six more recitations, with ayah-by-ayah audio from EveryAyah.com.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.9.1
item.description:
• 📅 Calendar: "Calendars to check" opens again, and turning prayer blocks off now says how many it removed.
  • 🗣 Siri: more ways to ask ("Salah Bar next prayer").

item.title: Salah Bar 2.9.0
item.description:
• 🕌 Iqama times for your mosque, with a countdown to the jama'ah.
  • ✅ Prayer log: tick off prayers, streaks, and an optional qada count.
  • 📅 Calendar: a warning when a meeting overlaps a prayer, and optional prayer blocks.
  • 🕋 Friday and Sunnah reminders: Al-Kahf on Fridays, Sunnah fasts, the last third of the night.
  • 📖 Hifz mode: repeat ayat with the Arabic text highlighted.
  • 🗣 Siri and Shortcuts.
  • 🔇 Other apps' music or videos pause during the adhan, then carry on.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.8.1
item.description:
• 🎙 Six new adhans, openly licensed and credited: the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah, the Great Mosque of Makkah, a Fajr adhan from Malmö, and recordings from Kazakhstan, the USA and Japan.
  • 🇹🇷 Turkish Hijri dates use Diyanet's month names ("24 Rebiülahir 1448 H.").
  • Clearer wording about your location: Salah Bar doesn't collect or share it.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.8.0
item.description: • 🧮 New prayer-time engine: Salah Bar now calculates the sun's position with its own code, built on the U.S. Naval Observatory's public formulas. Your prayer times stay exactly the same, to the second.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.3
item.description: • 🛠 Closing the lid stops the adhan: putting the Mac to sleep now stops the adhan and pauses the Quran, so they no longer carry on by themselves when you open it again.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.2
item.description: • 📖 Quran mini-player: click or drag its progress bar to jump anywhere in the surah, with the elapsed and total time under it.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.1
item.description: • 🛠 Large widget: for two minutes after each prayer begins, the card now says It's prayer time with that prayer and the ayah, and the next prayer as a small line. Before, it still said "Next prayer: Maghrib" while Asr was highlighted below.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.0
item.description:
• 📖 Listen to the Quran: 242 reciters, any surah. It streams by default; download surahs or a whole recitation to listen offline (on an external drive too).
  • Mini-player in the panel, media keys and Control Centre, resume where you stopped, repeat, sleep timer, favourites.
  • At prayer time the recitation fades out for the adhan, then carries on (Settings → Quran).
  • 🔕 Stop Flashing in the panel, or click the reminder, to stop the blinking before a prayer.
  • 🛠 Fixed a second adhan playing after stopping the first, when two copies of Salah Bar were open.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.2
item.description: Large widget fix: it could get stuck on a grey placeholder; it now prepares in about 2 seconds and refreshes reliably.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.1
item.description: Never miss an update: Salah Bar checks every 6 hours and tells you when a new version is out, with an Update Now banner in the panel and a notification.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.0
item.description: The right times wherever you are: the calculation method is now automatic by country. No wrong city when location is off, with an Allow Location button. 12-hour or 24-hour times (Settings → General).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.2
item.description: The Support Salah Bar button now opens Buy Me a Coffee: support by card or Apple Pay, no account needed.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.1
item.description: The Support Salah Bar button now opens the sponsorship page directly.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.0
item.description: A flash before the adhan: a soft green glow pulses around your screens when the warning starts, and the menu bar icon blinks until the adhan. Settings → Appearance → Flash warning (with Preview).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.2
item.description: Desktop widget: stays readable when macOS shows widgets faded or tinted, especially on light wallpapers.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.1
item.description: Salah Bar moved to github.com/be-liever95/salah-bar. Updates, the adhan library and the Support link use the new address; your settings and adhans carry over.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.0
item.description: Support Salah Bar: a new button in the menu panel and Settings → General. Salah Bar stays free and ad-free.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.3.1
item.description: Small fixes: the Arabic widget's Qibla distance shows the Arabic thousands separator, and Arabic adhan names display right-to-left in English and Turkish settings.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.3.0
item.description: Trim the adhan: choose exactly which part of any recording plays, with a waveform editor (✂︎ in Settings → Notifications). It fades out gently at your end point.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.2.0
item.description:
Add your own adhan: use any audio file, or pick from 169 adhans in the online library (Settings → Notifications → My adhans).

Arabic Qibla line fixes.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.1.0
item.description:
Arabic: the whole app, right to left, with Arabic-Indic digits (switchable).

A rotating ayah or dua: 42 ayahs, Quranic duas and hadiths in the menu panel and Large widget, changing every 15 minutes to once a day (Settings → Appearance).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.0.0
item.description:
The first native version of Salah Bar: one app instead of SwiftBar, Übersicht and a shell installer.

  • Menu bar countdown, prayer list, Hijri date and Qibla
  • Adhan with fade-in, reminders with a Silence button, quiet during calls
  • Desktop widgets in three sizes
  • Times calculated on your Mac and matched to the official Diyanet tables
  • Removes the old SwiftBar version for you
